headline: Medical admission candidate student commits suicide
summary: The student, who was preparing for medical admission tests, left a note stating he was thinking of doing something different.
details: A student preparing for medical college admission tests has committed suicide.
Before taking his own life, the student left a note saying, 'I am thinking of doing something different.'
The incident has caused shock and sadness among his peers and family members.
Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the event.
